description: Workflow-capability -> agent binding, for consumers that resolve 'what handles this step' without reading agents/*.md directly (e.g. the ai-se-os headless runner). Distinct from routing.json: routing answers a file-path question at edit time; this answers an abstract-workflow-step question a hook never asks. model_tier is always a hyphenated slug of one of rules/models.md's four tier names (that file's own table cell reads 'most capable', two words — this registry's identifier form is 'most-capable'), never a raw model alias — a bound entry's tier is the reverse lookup of its agent's frontmatter model; a note entry's tier is what the main Claude Code loop should use in the agent's place. Read by scripts/validate-engineos.sh (agent exists, tier is valid) and scripts/gen-agent-commands.sh's sibling generator for registries/agents.json's capability_ids back-reference.
